title: [Android Beta Client] Cannot connect to alternate (self-hosted) headscale server
body:
### What is the issue?

When adding self-hosted headscale server, Tailscale's login screen appears as if it didn't register the URL provided. The login was working with Tailscale stable app (1.41.1 and 1.60.0, both tested). Clearing Tailscale's data didnt fix it. Reinstalling the app didn't fix it either.

### Steps to reproduce

Settings -> Accounts -> dot and entering an address for self-hosted headscale server, login screen for tailscale apperas (with tailscale.com domain)

### Are there any recent changes that introduced the issue?

Updating to BETA Tailscale android client.

### OS

Android

### OS version

Android 14

### Tailscale version

v1.65.0-t220764331-g50bb25aca2d

### Other software

Headscale [v0.23.0-alpha5](https://github.com/juanfont/headscale/releases/tag/v0.23.0-alpha5)

### Bug report

BUG-df78f1ff5133b886ffdfd03bdd886d8385aea68764263175d9116b7ddcef1159-20240413080756Z-9c8ffd0aa0eaa162

comments.body:
> After 4 months, this bug occurs again. I installed tailscale from google play with the latest version. The exact ver number was "1.72.0-taa448d5a9-g". After tapping the "use an alternate server", the client went back to the home view, where the "Login in" did no response to any further tapping.

> May the kind maintainers re-open the issue and investigate it further. Thanks for all your hard work

I had the same issue today and I think I found why !
I'm using the tailscale android app from F-droid (Version 1.72.0 (254))  and the headscale server run in a docker container (image headscale/headscale:0.22.3).

I enter my headscale URL  in the "use alternate server" option and then nothing happens.

When I checked the logs of my docker container, see this each time I press login in the tailscale app:
> 2024-09-13T20:02:02Z INF go/src/headscale/hscontrol/protocol_common.go:574 > Successfully sent auth url AuthURL=http://headscale.domain.name:portnumber/register/nodekey:6f93231a259a0f8952db651a3359b332f9d1868a36 machine=localhost noise=true

I I manualy enter the URL in my favorite browser, I get this response:
> Client sent an HTTP request to an HTTPS server.

Now I change the url from HTTP to HTTPS and I now get the response with the informations to connect

So I think that the problem is not the tailscale app but the headscale server that is sending http URl instead of https.

As i'm currently using the latest stable headscale version (0.22.3), this behaviour may have been changed in the more recents version of headscale. 

Even with doing the instruction from the HTTPS url, I can't make it work so I found another way than using the login button:
1) in the account setting -> the three dots in the upper right of the screen -> "Use alternate server" and enter your headscale URL server
2) generate an authkey with `headscale preauthkeys create --user myfirstuser --reusable --expiration 24h`
3) in the account setting -> the three dots in the upper right of the screen -> "use auth key"
4) enter the authkey and click "add account"
5) enjoy your headscale network !

PS: url, port, nodekey have been anonymised
